avoid_dishes.dish: Xiao long bao and all dumplings or buns

name: Din Tai Fung
questions: Is the fried rice seasoned with any soy sauce, and if so is it GF?
Is the fried rice cooked in a wok also used for noodles?
Besides the fried rice, are there vegetable dishes made without regular soy or oyster sauce?
Is the chilli oil or dipping vinegar free of wheat or malt?

safe_dishes.note: FMGF lists fried rice as a GF item, and a reviewer reports a waiter who knew about celiac and said what was safe. Confirm the soy sauce and whether the wok is shared.

summary: The menu is mostly dumplings and noodles, so options are very limited. The one reported GF dish is the fried rice, from a single undated FMGF review describing celiac-aware staff.
